_comment: Hand-maintained set config. Prices are filled in automatically by scripts/update-prices.ps1. pullRates are the percent of packs containing each rarity, from the study in pullRateSource. A rate given as {percent, match} counts cards whose product name contains 'match' (e.g. Master Ball Pattern) instead of matching on rarity. Bulk value per pack is worked out by the update script from real card prices (optional per-set packLayout overrides the cards-per-pack counts). Optional 'note' is shown on the site for that set. Products with kind 'collection' only count their booster packs (promos and accessories aren't valued). A product's optional 'contents' lists packs by set (plus 'bonus' guaranteed cards) when it isn't just N packs of its own set; 'priceGroupId' says which TCGplayer group lists its price. 'collections' holds products whose packs span several sets.

sets.name: 30th Celebration
